text:
[RLOW.7.8.1] DS source comments per LGRA.2.4 (`#…` to end of
line) are non-semantic. They are **preserved** through
compilation by the `DsSource` atom ([RDSC.14]),
which carries the module's original DS source text verbatim
— comments and all. A tool that wants a node's source context reads it from
`DsSource[module_id]` via the node's `LineSpan` atom
([RDSC.14.3]).

---
